cohort: The study included 335 very low birth weight (VLBW) preterm infants admitted to a tertiary-care neonatal intensive care unit between January 2016 and June 2019.
finding: Complete antenatal steroid exposure was associated with significantly lower rates of acute kidney injury and improved renal function in very low birth weight preterm infants compared with no antenatal steroids.
followup_time: up to 2 weeks of life and at discharge
